name: Fathom
summary: AI meeting recorder, transcriber and note-taker.
description: Fathom records, transcribes and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings, and syncs notes and action items to CRMs. It is known for a generous free-forever plan for individuals. Paid plans add advanced AI summaries, team sharing, coaching and CRM integrations.
